title_en: Trip.com, China's largest travel platform, fined 1 trillion won
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Trip.com, China's largest online travel platform, was sanctioned by Chinese authorities worth 770 million dollars (about 1.0864 trillion won) on charges of abusing its market dominant position. According to the Financial Times (FT) on the 7th (local time), China's State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) paid Trip.com 5.18 billion yuan (about 700 million won) after a six-month antitrust investigation. A fine of $70 million was imposed. This is because Trip.com is judged to have used its market-dominant position to impose unreasonable transaction conditions on hotel operators. Trip.com has held a share of more than 50% in China's online hotel reservation market for five consecutive years until 2025. During this period, sales in China tripled. Last year, global sales recorded 62.5 billion yuan (about 13.0787 trillion won), a 17% increase from the previous year. Most of its sales occurred in mainland China. Founded in 1999 as Ctrip, Trip.com has grown into China's largest online travel platform since it was listed on the U.S. Nasdaq in 2003. It is far ahead of competitors such as Fliggy, which Alibaba invested in, and Tongcheng, China's second largest travel platform. summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] There is news that the Indian government is creating a ‘Telecommunication Manufacturing Special Zone (TMZ)’ to foster the country’s telecommunication equipment manufacturing ecosystem. According to RightReading.com, the Indian government plans to establish India's first special telecommunication manufacturing zone in Gwalior, central Madhya Pradesh. title_en: “SK Hynix considers selling stake in Chongqing factory in China worth 4 trillion won”
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] There was a foreign media report that SK Hynix is ​​considering multiple options, including selling shares of its Chongqing plant in China. As it is pursuing investment in large-scale production facilities in Yongin and Cheongju, attention is being paid to whether this is a move to secure future investment resources and improve asset efficiency. According to Bloomberg on the 9th, SK Hynix is ​​reviewing various options, including attracting external investors to its Chongqing plant in China. To this end, it has been reported that an advisory firm has been selected. If the transaction is completed, the corporate value of the Chongqing plant is expected to be valued at approximately $3 billion (approximately 4.2 trillion won). Potential investors include Chinese funds and local companies. It is known that SK Hynix is ​​also considering retaining a minority stake in the Chongqing plant even after the transaction. title_en: LGU+ manages internet quality with AI… Wi-Fi 8 technology demonstration
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] LG U+ has succeeded in verifying intelligent home network technology that analyzes internet quality in home routers in real time through AI, detects abnormalities, and automatically recovers. LG U+ announced on the 9th that it has demonstrated home network automatic recovery technology using the Wi-Fi 8 (Wi-Fi platform) in cooperation with Broadcom. The core of the demonstration is Edge AI technology, which analyzes and optimizes the network status directly on the home router rather than a cloud server. The existing network responds after Internet quality drops. Furthermore, it is a method in which AI detects and responds to abnormal signs before users notice a decrease in quality. As services that use large amounts of data, such as generative AI, extended reality (XR), cloud games, and ultra-high-definition IPTV, are increasing, the speed and stability of home networks are becoming important, so the telecommunications industry is continuing to develop AI-based network technology that identifies and optimizes network conditions in real time. LG U+ is based on edge AI that directly runs AI on the router with Broadcom, a global semiconductor company, to verify the technology. A home network environment was established. Broadcom provided a Wi-Fi 8 platform equipped with an NPU that supports AI calculations.
